lines: 另一条光线$AD$通过焦点，折
射后，它平行于主光轴. 这两条
折射线的交点就是点$A$的像
$A_1$. 同样可以做出所有其余点
的像. 不应当认为图像只是由
两条或三条光线组成的：它是
由从点$A$发出的，会聚在点$A_1$
的无数光线形成的. 其中穿过透镜的光心$O$的光线$AOA_1$射
至$A_1$点. 这样一来，为了作出各点的像可以利用三条“特殊”
光线中的任意两条. 这三条光线通过透镜的光路是知道的：
1) 穿过光心的光线；2) 平行于主光轴入射到透镜的光线；
3) 穿过焦点的光线.
我们再研究一种情况：即需要作出位于主光轴上点的像.
这时困难在于所有这三条方便的光线都合并成一条与主光轴
重合的光线. 所以需要确定射
至透镜上的任一点$B$的光线$SB$
的光路(图 180). 为作出折射线
我们作平行于光线$SB$的副光
轴$PQ$，然后作焦平面$F$，求出
焦平面与副光轴的交点$C$. 折
射线$BC$就通过$C$点. 这样一来，就作出了$S$点发出的两条
光线的光路. 经透镜折射后，这两条光线发散. 因为光源位
于焦点和透镜之间，所以点$S$的像$S_1$是虚像.

requirements.requirement: Join the actual incoming construction: AD passes through the near focus and emerges parallel to the principal axis; its refracted intersection with the AC ray locates A_1. Retain that other object points can be imaged similarly, and that the real image is formed by many rays, not only the two or three used for the construction. Preserve AO through the optical center and A_1, with fig179. Keep the source thin-lens/paraxial conditions; do not invent image distances or scale.

Retain that any two independent special rays suffice, and the complete naturally ordered three-item prose enumeration: through the optical center, incident parallel to the principal axis, and through the focus. They are teaching rules, not three new unsolved exercises; each must display on its own line in the modern edition. Do not treat coincident axial rays as independent construction information.

Retain the axial-object-point case: the three convenient rays coincide with the principal axis, so trace SB to a lens point B using the secondary axis PQ parallel to SB. Intersect that axis with the focal plane through F at C and send the refracted ray BC through C. Preserve both the axial ray and the constructed oblique ray; with S between the focus and the converging lens their backward extensions locate virtual image S_1. Preserve fig180, point names, focal-plane versus point distinction and original whole construction; no guessed measurements or actual backward light propagation.

finalTail: 于焦点和透镜之间，所以点$S$的像$S_1$是虚像.
